title: Stellar module descriptor (<Id>.stellar.module)
description: The identity of a module in the engine. Only Id is required: everything else has a default, and an entry of manifests/engine.manifest.json may replace any field.

Id.description: The identifier: also the assembly and the package name. The file must be named <Id>.stellar.module

Version.description: The version of the module and of its package. The engine version when omitted

Level.description: The architectural level: a module depends only on strictly lower levels. HighLevel when omitted

Description.description: What the module is for, in one sentence. It becomes the package description

Project.description: The managed project, relative to the module folder. When omitted: src/Managed/<Id>/<Id>.csproj, src/<Id>/<Id>.csproj or <Id>.csproj. An empty string: the module has none

NativeProjects.description: The native projects in build order, relative to the module folder. When omitted: every .vcxproj under src/Native, then src/NativeInterop

TestProjects.description: The test projects, relative to the module folder. When omitted: every .csproj and .vcxproj under tests

Dependencies.description: The modules this one depends on. Stellar.Kernel and Stellar.Core are implicit
